blockers: CONTRACT CONFLICT (unit acceptance vs /legacy baseline failure): Verified baseline receipt (fixture_evidence) shows 'python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_app.py -v' exits 1 because tests/test_app.py:11 test_existing_contract asserts handle('/legacy', {}, {})[0] == 200 while src/app.py returns 404 for any path other than '/quote'. The intent simultaneously requires (a) all unit checks pass for this exact candidate with no baseline failure waived, and (b) the existing /legacy failure be preserved and kept separate from the endpoint change. The unit acceptance command runs the entire test_app.py suite, so it cannot exit 0 while test_existing_contract remains unchanged. Resolving this requires one of: (i) implementing /legacy -> 200 behavior in src/app.py (unrequested behavior change not authorized by the intent), (ii) modifying/removing/skipping test_existing_contract (waiving or weakening a baseline failure, explicitly forbidden), or (iii) controller/operator confirmation of an authorized resolution. Per stage rules, an existing failing regression is evidence of a contract conflict, not permission to change its expected result, so no repair is chosen in this plan.

SCOPE AMBIGUITY (/quote vs /api/quote): The intent says 'Expose /api/quote' but the existing handler and all three passing quote tests (test_quote, test_invalid, test_missing_price) use the path '/quote'. It is not established whether the requested behavior explicitly supersedes the '/quote' path (tests updated to '/api/quote', '/quote' removed) or whether '/quote' must continue to work alongside '/api/quote'. Choosing either option changes existing assertions without explicit authorization; a decision is required on whether '/quote' remains a supported route.

risks: Baseline risk (verified): unit acceptance exits 1 at baseline due to test_existing_contract (/legacy expects 200, handler returns 404). This finding is preserved and reported separately from the /api/quote change; it is not waived by this plan.

If the decision keeps '/quote' as a supported route alongside '/api/quote', the handler must match both paths; if it supersedes '/quote', the three existing quote tests must be re-pointed, changing existing assertions.

Symbol validation ordering matters: the current code checks the symbol before MARKET_API_URL, so a blank symbol with missing config returns 422, not 503; the intent does not specify precedence, so the existing order is retained.
price values from the query are passed through unvalidated (e.g., non-numeric values would be returned as-is); the intent only requires defaulting to 12.5 and preserving null.
